notes.title: Rocket Frog Version 1.0.4 Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all players of Rocket Frog,

The Rocket Frog Version 1.0.4 update is available now, and has some [b]NEW CHANGES!!![/b]

[h2]Ver. 1.0.4 Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Japanese Translation[/b] has been added! You can now select from either Japanese or English from the options menu!
[/list][list]
[*][b]Game Performance Improvements:[/b] Levels have been optimized to improve frame rate and gameplay.
[/list]

Thank you for playing Rocket Frog!

notes.title: Rocket Frog Version 1.0.3 Has Now Released!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all players of Rocket Frog far and near,

The Rocket Frog Version 1.0.3 update is out now, and has [b]IMPORTANT CHANGES!!![/b]

[h2]Ver. 1.0.3 Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Story Mode[/b] and [b]Arcade Mode[/b] added!
[/list][list]
[*][b]Story Mode:[/b] This will be an easier mode of gameplay! It will [b]Save Level Progress[/b] and have [b]Continue Points[/b] from the Level you were last on!
[/list][list]
[*][b]Arcade Mode:[/b] This mode will be a Harder Challenge! It has [b]NO Continue Points[/b] and [b]NO Saved Level Progression![/b]
[/list]

Let me know if you have any issues, and thank you for playing Rocket Frog!

notes.title: Rocket Frog Version 1.0.2 Has Released!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all players of Rocket Frog,

Rocket Frog Version 1.0.2 is now available, and shall be sent out into the wild!

[h2]Ver. 1.0.2 Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where color of top and bottom in cutscenes did not match.
[/list][list]
[*]Fixed issue where some Tiles were misplaced.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added more platforms to the end of Level 1.1 and the beginning of Level 3.1
 to make them a bit easier.
[/list]

Let me know if you have any issues, and thank you for playing Rocket Frog!
